source_window.publisher: Planning Data / Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government

field_evidence.dataset_semantics: Title boundary polygons show the position and indicative extent of a registered property.
field_evidence.target_binding: No verified BUILDING_PRESENT producer record in this lineage is explicitly linked to this title-boundary entity.

first_missing_criterion: Verified BUILDING_PRESENT canonical parcel geometry/bbox for this producer. The official Planning Data Title boundary dataset exposes HM Land Registry index-polygon geometry and the concrete entity title-boundary:32999489 provides a MULTIPOLYGON with authoritative-source quality, but the dataset defines title boundaries as showing only the position and indicative extent of a registered property. This concrete source polygon is not bound to any verified BUILDING_PRESENT producer record in this lineage, and spatial matching/materialization is reserved for local OpenCode. Local OpenCode must bind the target BUILDING_PRESENT record to a target-specific canonical parcel/title polygon; after that, bind one exact official DEM/LIDAR tile or metadata-index record to the resulting bbox.
exact_blocker: The method materially changed from identifier-only OS linkage to a concrete official-government title-boundary polygon payload. Planning Data reports HM Land Registry as the provider, marks the concrete entity as authoritative-source quality, and publishes its MULTIPOLYGON under OGL v3.0. However, the dataset explicitly describes these polygons as the position and indicative extent of a registered property, not a definitive canonical parcel boundary. The sampled title-boundary entity is also not target-bound to a verified BUILDING_PRESENT producer record. Therefore it is counted only as source-area evidence and not parcel progress; spatial join/materialization remains local OpenCode work.
